raw_segments.text: Bottom, that will ask some tears in the true performing of it.
If I do it, let the audience look to their eyes.
I will move storms, I will condole in some measure.
To the rest, yet my chief humor is for a tyrant.
I could play Urkel's rarely or apart to tear a cat in to make all split.
The raging rocks and shivering shock shall break the locks of prison gates, and Phibiscar
shall shine from far and make and mar the foolish fates.
Now name the rest of the players.
This is Urkel's vane, a tyrant's vane.
